name: oas4_h3_test_mlm_esm2_n1000
endpoint: Framework-averaged native edit similarity; length, diversity, conditional recovery and judge scores are supporting.
limits: Tier 1 held-out test evaluation of the two existing no-partner MLM ESM-2 35M checkpoints (seeds 42-43, with saved length heads and frozen ESM-2 tokenizers) on the exact same n=1,000 leakage-filtered test manifest and frozen heavy-only IgBert judge as oas4_h3_test_final_n1000.
Completes the symmetric pretrained-backbone held-out comparison alongside S2S ESM-2 35M and adapted IgLM/IgLM-S outside the 16-contrast seven-seed scratch primary family.
Saved checkpoints retain their 21-22 October training source/runtime; benchmark inference and scoring pin the current source.
